name: Hour One
tagline: Hour One turns scripts into professional presenter-led videos using realistic virtual human avatars. L&D teams, marketers, and content creators use it to produce training videos, product explainers, and marketing content without cameras, studios, or actors. You pick an avatar, paste in a script, and the platform generates a finished video in minutes.
